sections.title: Arthur W. *"Buzz" Rich*
body: Buzz Rich was admitted to practice in South Carolina in 1973 and established his Aiken firm in 1981.
He earned his bachelor's degree at Wofford College and his law degree at the University of South Carolina.

items.a: 205 Barnwell Avenue NW in Aiken. Mail goes to Drawer 1690, Aiken, SC 29802.

items.q: Do you handle closings for buyers and sellers?
items.a: The firm handles residential and commercial real estate closings. Call to talk through yours.

items.q: My parent has died. Can you help with the estate?
items.a: Probate is one of the firm's practice areas. Call (803) 649-3923 to set a time to talk.

sections.title: Have a closing or an estate to plan?
sections.text: Call the office on Barnwell Avenue.
